urban_buildings.title: Millcreek 3D buildings for ArcGIS Urban, UTM 12N (2023 lidar), planning estimate
urban_buildings.snippet: Unvalidated planning estimate: the 21,561 three-way hybrid buildings (roofer LoD 2.2, Esri fallbacks) in NAD83(2011) UTM 12N for a local ArcGIS Urban model, with an estimated floor count.
urban_buildings.coordinates: Coordinates: NAD83(2011) / UTM zone 12N (EPSG 6341), metres, the lidar's own coordinate system; no datum transformation. For local scenes and a local ArcGIS Urban model in 6341. Elevations NAVD88 (Geoid18) metres.

urban_footprints.title: Millcreek building footprints for ArcGIS Urban, UTM 12N (2023 lidar), planning estimate
urban_footprints.snippet: Unvalidated planning estimate: one footprint per 3D building (21,561), with roof height, model level and an estimated floor count, in NAD83(2011) UTM 12N for a local ArcGIS Urban model.
urban_footprints.coordinates: Coordinates: NAD83(2011) / UTM zone 12N (EPSG 6341), metres, the lidar's own coordinate system; no datum transformation. For local scenes and a local ArcGIS Urban model in 6341. Elevations NAVD88 (Geoid18) metres.

urban_terrain.title: Millcreek bare-earth terrain for ArcGIS Urban, UTM 12N 0.5 m (2023 lidar), planning estimate
urban_terrain.snippet: Unvalidated LiDAR planning estimate. Bare-earth elevation in metres, NAVD88, at 0.5 m on a NAD83(2011) UTM 12N tiling scheme, as the elevation layer of a local ArcGIS Urban model. Not a surveyed surface.
urban_terrain.coordinates: Coordinates: NAD83(2011) / UTM zone 12N (EPSG 6341), metres, the lidar's own coordinate system; no datum transformation. For local scenes and a local ArcGIS Urban model in 6341. Elevations NAVD88 (Geoid18) metres.

urban_basemap.title: Millcreek light basemap for ArcGIS Urban, UTM 12N (2023 lidar hillshade)
urban_basemap.snippet: Light reference basemap in NAD83(2011) UTM 12N on the Millcreek Urban terrain's tiling scheme, so a local ArcGIS Urban model can be created: lidar hillshade, parcel lines, street names, city boundary.
urban_basemap.coordinates: Coordinates: NAD83(2011) / UTM zone 12N (EPSG 6341), metres, the lidar's own coordinate system; no datum transformation. For local scenes and a local ArcGIS Urban model in 6341. Elevations NAVD88 (Geoid18) metres.
